confidence.rationale: CursorWrapProperties constructs all members before deserialization, so null checks cannot detect omitted properties; the current constructor also keeps new settings at version 1.0.

proposed_comments.body:
### Version the settings migration

**Severity:** `medium`

`CursorWrapProperties` initializes every property before JSON is applied, so older settings files that omit `disable_cursor_wrap_in_game_mode` still deserialize with a non-null default and never trigger `UpgradeSettingsConfiguration`. Bump the current settings version and migrate `Version == "1.0"` to `1.1`, explicitly persisting the new default; this preserves existing settings while ensuring the new schema is written.
proposed_comments.reason: Companion guidance: the safe fix spans the constructor version and migration method, so one self-contained inline suggestion would be unsafe.
